text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOOH!!
I'm a hero toooooo!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I'm de-finitely gonna beat No. 1... wait, what!?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOH, I don't care if I burn to ashes!!
This one and only chance—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Seizing victory is what a true hero does!!
Full power unleashed! Justice Burst—!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: BOOOOONOOOOO!!
She ran. She captivated the crowd. And in the end—her deadly finishing burst settled the race.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The clash of heroes is settled here!
Conquering this mile showdown across the biggest size difference is—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Biko Pegasus!!! The little hero has now
reached the pinnacle of the sprint division!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOOAAAH, did you see that?!
That's right! I'm the one who's—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: It's a herooo!!
(Uwooooooah!)

text_block_list.name: Film Director
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what... drama...
What... pure emotion...

text_block_list.name: Film Director
text_block_list.text: I want to direct a movie starring her someday! Just as you said, she's a magnificent Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Director.
Congratulations, Biko-chan.

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text: I saw it loud and clear—your Carrot Spirit!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Traineeeer, we did it, we did it,
we did itttt!!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: "Did you see me?! In the final stretch, when I went *whooosh* right past everyone!"
choice_data_list: Yeah, you are— you're my hero!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Trainer...! You're the one and only captain for me, got that?!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: "Because you were there for me, Trainer, I was able to become the person I always dreamed of being!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Mm-hmm, I'm glad too~. I guess it really is too early for me to be a hero.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Please keep being my hero. And let's
stay best friends forever, Biko-chan!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Ah, of course, Bono!
And so, the victorious Biko Pegasus—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: To-o-oh!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Mission complete! Carotene MAX!
Justice Biko here. Thanks for your support!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Listen up, everyone!
When I was little, I didn't understand
a single thing about heroes.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I might still not understand that much even now.
But there's just one thing I do know.
And that is—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: It means no one starts out as a hero from the very beginning!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Carrotman kept losing too, but in the end he won.
I was tiny and weak, but
today, I won."

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"That's right, anyone can be a hero!
Everyone here in the stands, and all the kiddos watching on TV!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
And so, until we meet again! Wherever there's
a call for action, I'll be there in a flash!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Shake my hand at the racetrack!!
Carotene... MAAAAX!!!!!!!
A small body, a disadvantageous running style. But her dreams and courage are limitless.

On this day, Biko Pegasus became a true hero,
every bit as great as Carrotman.
That night—
(*Tap, tap, tap...*)

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Film Director
text_block_list.text: You've arrived, Justice Biko.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Ah, you're...

text_block_list.name: Film Director
text_block_list.text: Your appearance is confirmed. Go and become a beacon of an even greater justice.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

Justice Biko will return...
probably.
